outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body:
- Management is cautiously optimistic about the outlook for the agricultural sector and its business operations
- Continued focus on agricultural productivity, food security, rural infrastructure, modern farming techniques and food processing is expected to support long-term demand for agricultural products and inputs
- Increasing farmer awareness and the adoption of technology-enabled agricultural practices are expected to provide opportunities for the Company
- Demand is expected to be sustained by rising population, increasing food consumption and changing dietary preferences, and by growing farmer awareness of productivity, crop quality and climate resilience
- Growth in food processing, organised retail and agricultural exports is cited as an opportunity for higher value addition and increased demand for quality agricultural produce
- Margin levers flagged the other way: volatility in raw material prices, logistics costs and other input costs may affect operating margins, and competition from several domestic and international players may pressure pricing, margins and market share
- Performance is stated to be influenced by prevailing market conditions, demand for agricultural products, crop conditions, input costs, competitive pressures and other economic factors

litigation.note: The Secretarial Audit Report (Form MR-3) in this profile bundle reports, under 'We further report that', that SEBI passed an adjudication order under Section 15-I of the SEBI Act read with Rule 5 of the SEBI (Procedure for Holding Inquiry and Imposing Penalties) Rules, 1995 in respect of price and volume manipulation in the scrip of Quasar India Limited, passed on 31st October 2025, and that the matter was ongoing as at the year ended 31st March 2026. The report does not state how Chandrima Mercantiles or its management is connected to that order, so the nature of the Company's involvement cannot be read off this bundle. The same bundle also records a secretarial-audit exception: non-compliance with Regulation 47 of SEBI LODR on publication of the newspaper advertisement for the results for the quarter and year ended 31st March 2025, and the resignation of the statutory auditor w.e.f. 14th November 2025. No amounts are disclosed.
